description: US economy latest (BLS) — Latest official US macro prints from the Bureau of Labor Statistics in one call: headline and core CPI, PPI final demand (month-over-month and year-over-year %), unemployment rate, labor force participation, nonfarm payrolls change, and average hourly earnings, plus a one-line summary and trend signals (inflation RISING/EASING/STEADY, labor market WEAKENING/STRENGTHENING/STABLE, 3-month average payroll gain). Optional indicators=cpi,core_cpi,ppi,unemployment_rate,participation_rate,payrolls,hourly_earnings and months=1-13 of history (default 6). Public-domain BLS data, refreshed every 6 hours. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: econ_us_latest
